drivingQuestion: Must one worry that the bundle buyer resells for idol worship?

segments.he: וְלֵיחוּשׁ דִּלְמָא אָזֵיל וּמְזַבֵּין לְאַחֲרִינֵי וּמַקְטְרִי! אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: אַ״לִּפְנֵי״ מִפַּקְּדִינַן, אַ״לִּפְנֵי״ דְּ״לִפְנֵי״ לָא מִפַּקְּדִינַן.
segments.en: The Gemara raises a difficulty: «But let us be concerned lest» the buyer «go and sell» these items «to another» gentile, «and they sacrifice» them. «Abaye said» in response: This scenario is certainly possible, but «we are commanded» only not «to» “place a stumbling block «before» the blind” (Leviticus 19:14), i.e., one may not be the direct cause of a gentile’s idol worship. «We are not commanded» not «to» place a stumbling block «before» one who may subsequently place it «before» the blind.
